say:0:1320616001:1.text: In a coffin, a tall body is wrapped in a ragged velvet robe that may have once been a brighter shade but has turned brown over time.
say:0:1320616001:1.source_cn: 一具高大的尸骨躺在石棺中，盖着件破烂的天鹅绒长袍，长袍...

say:3:1320616003:0.text: I recognize the dark pattern on this robe... It's Magister Angus.
say:3:1320616003:0.source_cn: 我认得这袍子上的暗纹……是奥列格老师？

choice_prompt:4:1320616003.text: I recognize the dark pattern on this robe... It's Magister Angus.
choice_prompt:4:1320616003.source_cn: 我认得这袍子上的暗纹……是奥列格老师？

say:5:1320616004:1.text: The gods blessed our family with magical talent. When we were very young, our parents wanted to hire an experienced magister to teach us how to use our magic. That's how Magister Angus came into our lives.
say:5:1320616004:1.source_cn: 蒙神眷顾，我们家族有些魔法天赋和渊源，父母在我们很小的...

say:6:1320616005:1.text: He was strict and very knowledgeable. My brother and I were always afraid of his ruler.
say:6:1320616005:1.source_cn: 他铁面，严肃，知识渊博，我和哥哥都很害怕他的戒尺。

say:7:1320616006:1.text: Oh, no! Were you two punished a lot?

say:8:1320616007:1.text: Magister Angus treated me fine. My punishments included more homework and a good scolding. But my brother... He's the heir of the family, so he faced harsher discipline.
say:8:1320616007:1.source_cn: 奥列格老师对我还好，只是训斥。但是哥哥他……他是家族的...

say:9:1320616008:1.text: Our magister always said my brother's magical talents couldn't match mine, so he needed to study harder... and he did. Callan would spend the whole day inside with his books, trying his best to complete every assignment.
say:9:1320616008:1.source_cn: 老师说，哥哥的魔法天赋不如我，所以他需要更多磨炼……他...

say:10:1320616009:1.text: But in the end, he still faced the ruler.
say:10:1320616009:1.source_cn: 但最后，戒尺还是会敲在他的手心上。

say:12:1320616010:0.text: No amount of effort can surpass innate talent. For individuals without natural skills, striving to succeed in areas they're not adept at is an excruciating ordeal.
say:12:1320616010:0.source_cn: 后天努力永远抵不过天赋异禀。对没有天赋的人来说，强迫去...

say:13:1320616011:0.text: But such is the burden of an heir. For Callan to uphold the Radinov name, much had to be endured.
say:13:1320616011:0.source_cn: 但这就是身为继承人的职责。铐兰要担得起拉季诺夫之名，就...

say:14:1320616012:0.text: A noble title becomes a heavy yoke when it falls on certain people.
say:14:1320616012:0.source_cn: 尊贵的头衔，落在具体的人身上就是沉重的枷锁。
